## Problem

What user or engineering problem does this solve? Link issue/RFC/ADR.

## Change and alternatives

Explain the approach, important tradeoffs, and alternatives considered.

## Verification

List exact tests, fixtures, benchmarks, docs previews, and manual checks.

## Risk and compatibility

Describe security, privacy, accessibility, performance, cross-platform, schema/API, migration, external effects, and rollback implications.

## Documentation and release

- [ ] User/developer documentation updated or `no-docs-needed` explained.
- [ ] Changelog/release intent added or `no-release-note` explained.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, unlicensed assets, or hidden generated output.
